description: Optional keywords of ALTER TABLE's column clauses (live-verified): DROP with or without COLUMN (single, comma-list, IF EXISTS), DROP CLUSTERING KEY / DROP PRIMARY KEY, NOT NULL with or without SET in the ALTER/MODIFY/COLUMN-less spellings, a MASKING POLICY in the column definition (WITH optional) on CREATE and ADD COLUMN, and FORCE replacing an attached policy where the plain form refuses (attachment asserted behaviourally via the already-attached refusal). Converted 1:1 from ddl/AlterColumnClauseFormsTest (now retired).
